# Fate UI v0.9.7-beta3

This beta updates the embedded Pi SDK to 0.85.0, reduces streaming overhead, and fixes session handling and navigation. The base version remains 0.9.7.

## Changes since v0.9.7-beta2

- Saved-session references restore through the SDK's new in-memory API. Tagging a session no longer migrates or repairs its file. References respect the active branch, support compaction checkpoints, redact secrets, and reject stale identities or cyclic paths.
- Basic Prompt Optimization uses the selected model without inheriting the coding session's extended reasoning budget. Advanced Prompt Improvement keeps its research step and settings. Cancelling a stalled rewrite releases the composer without aborting the coding session.
- Stop now cancels manual SDK compaction too.
- Unchanged assistant Markdown no longer reparses on unrelated renders. Performance mode disables transitions completely and batches provisional output for up to 64 ms; Holy sh*t uses up to 200 ms. Buffers have fixed limits, coalesce redundant tool snapshots, and preserve cursor ordering. Completion, errors, queues, provenance, and session changes remain immediate.
- Height-driven scrolling replaces the repeated settling loop and delayed auto-scroll callbacks. New prompts follow correctly when their response or first tool arrives in the same batch; manual scrolling stays in control. End targets the final virtual item instead of an estimated scroll height.
- Disposed hydration requests and buffered events cannot replay into a different session. The manual fork smoke launcher uses a private profile instead of deleting shared instance profiles.

## Dependencies and verification

Electron moves to 43.6.0 and the speech runtime to 0.2.3, alongside compatible rendering and test-package updates. Radix popover stays on 1.1.22 after its newer patch failed the permission-picker test. yt-dlp was already on the latest stable release, 2026.08.19. Framework major versions remain unchanged.

The update includes regression tests for all three performance modes, SDK restoration, cancellation, event bounds, cursor ordering, and navigation. Native workflows verify Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. A non-promotion manual run stages seven installers and `SHA256SUMS` for 14 days without creating a tag or publishing a release.

Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
